verdict.rationale: Pipecat lets developers swap among many integrated speech/STT providers, usually with one line of code, and community evidence confirms local Whisper STT works. Its docs cover real-time STT final-transcript latency (TTFS), per-service latency tuning, and transcript collection through turn events, so provider control over real-time transcription is clearly documented. Missing for 10: evidence of transcription accuracy, documented control over STT language/model selection or key-term/custom-vocabulary boosting, and independent hands-on corroboration of transcription quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate real-time transcription with control over the STT provider, language models, or key terms

citations.quote: Swap speech, language, and vision services from any of 200+ integrated providers and services — usually one line of code.
Time To Final Segment (TTFS) measures how long it takes from the moment a user stops speaking until the STT service delivers the final transcript.
Pipecat ships with measured P99 latency values for each supported service so that turn detection can account for this delay automatically.
Local STT is also supported via whisper, which pipecat will download and manage for you.
Pipecat's turn events make it easy to collect both user and assistant messages as they occur.
